verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own materials say it joins or autojoins meetings to record, transcribe and summarize. They also promise 'detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting,' which covers the core of a post-meeting structured summary with next steps. Sharing is supported via the meeting share tool. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated 'decisions' section, no evidence summaries are reliable enough to share without editing, and no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
